communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: DRT NW Intel
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All messages, including text, images, attachments, voice notes, and associated metadata (sender, recipients, timestamps), sent or received by any Uvalde Police Department employee or official in the following WhatsApp group chats, and in any predecessor or successor versions of them, from January 1, 2024, through the date of your search:
- "DRT NW Intel 3.0"
- "NWHG 3.0"
- "ZAV-FRIO-SIU-UVA-MED"
2. Any other WhatsApp, Signal or text-message group chats from the same period that Uvalde Police Department personnel use to exchange information with U.S. Border Patrol or U.S. Customs and Border Protection personnel. For these chats, I request the group names, creation dates, and records sufficient to show which agencies participate.
3. Any policy, general order, memorandum or guidance in effect from January 1, 2024, to the present that governs Uvalde Police Department personnel's use of WhatsApp or other messaging applications for official business, and the retention of those messages.
4. Any agreement, memorandum of understanding, or task-force or Operation Lone Star document governing information sharing between Uvalde Police Department and U.S. Border Patrol in effect during the same period.

Messages on personal devices: Under Tex. Gov't Code § 552.002(a-2), communications about official business are public information regardless of the device or account used to create or maintain them. Employees and officials who hold such communications are temporary custodians under §§ 552.003(7) and 552.233, and must surrender or preserve them. Please search personal devices and accounts where personnel used them to take part in the chats described above.

Withholding: If you believe any portion of the requested information is excepted from disclosure, please release all portions that are not excepted, and request a ruling from the Office of the Attorney General within 10 business days as required by § 552.301. Please send me a copy of any such ruling request. I am not seeking officers' personal phone numbers or home addresses, and you may redact those without an Attorney General ruling where the Act permits.

Timing and format: Please produce the information promptly under § 552.221. If you cannot produce it within 10 business days, please certify in writing the date and hour it will be available. I request electronic copies in native format, or as screenshots or exports showing sender, timestamp and full content, delivered by email or file-sharing link. Please provide records on a rolling basis.

Preservation: Please notify the relevant personnel to preserve all responsive messages while this request is pending, including messages that WhatsApp's disappearing-message settings could otherwise delete.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: Bryan TX Flock Audit Records
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

 I am requesting copies of all audit logs, search logs, or usage reports related to your agency's use of Flock "ALPR" systems for the period of 01/01/2024 through 10/15/2026. This includes but is not limited to:

    Records of license plate searches performed by agency personnel
    Timestamps of searches
    User identification information (names, badge numbers, or user IDs)
    Any associated case numbers or investigation references
    A list of network share settings (the networks shared with your agency and the networks your agency shares out)
    Event logs or system activity logs, including hotlist and network-sharing changes
    Screenshots of relevant configuration settings, including network-sharing and live-stream access settings 

Some of these records may be available as the "Organization Audit" in the Flock software's "Insights" section.

Please provide records in their original electronic format (CSV, Excel, or similar)

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Nayab Warach

title: Daniel Lurie and Charles Lutvak Communications

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: Daniel Lurie and Charles Lutvak Communications
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All text messages, Signal messages, emails, and other written or electronic communications between San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie and Charles Lutvak from January 1, 2024, through October 15, 2026, concerning City business, public policy, governmental decision-making, political strategy relating to official City actions, or the operations of the Mayor’s Office.
2. All deleted text messages, Signal messages, emails, and other written or electronic communications between San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie and Charles Lutvak from January 1, 2024, through October 15, 2026, including receipts and meta data showing the messages were deleted if the messages themselves are not available. 
3. All contracts, agreements, memoranda, engagement letters, invoices, payment records, and documents defining Charles Lutvak’s responsibilities, authority, compensation, or relationship with Mayor Daniel Lurie or the City and County of San Francisco, including records concerning Lutvak’s involvement in communicating, advising on, or conducting official City business during the same period.
4. All communications between Daniel Lurie and Charles Lutvak concerning Lutvak’s participation in meetings, negotiations, communications with public officials, policy development, administrative decisions, or other governmental activities undertaken on behalf of the Mayor or the City.
5. Daniel Lurie's phone contract for the phone that he uses for official business.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson

title: BIA Agreements with Othram Inc. Regarding Forensic Genetic Genealogy and Indigenous Genomic Data

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: BIA Agreements with Othram Inc. Regarding Forensic Genetic Genealogy and Indigenous Genomic Data
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Concerning agreements between the Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA), Office of Justice Services, Missing and Murdered Unit, and Othram Inc., including records associated with Operation Spirit Return.

Specifically, I request:

1. Blanket Purchase Agreement 140A1622A0008, including all applicable terms, conditions, and modifications.
2. Task orders 140A1623F0099, 140A1624F0056, 140A1625F0083, and 140A1626F0068, including statements of work and attachments.
3. Agreements addressing ownership, access, storage, retention, destruction, or secondary use of genetic and genomic data generated from Indigenous human remains.
4. Provisions concerning Tribal consultation, informed consent, Tribal data sovereignty, and authorization for genomic sequencing.
5. Agreements governing the transfer of genomic information to third-party genetic genealogy databases.
6. Data-sharing, privacy, and intellectual property agreements governing raw sequencing data, SNP profiles, and derivative information.

I am particularly interested in understanding whether Tribal Nations retain authority over genetic information derived from their citizens or ancestors and whether such information may be used for purposes beyond the original identification investigation.

Please provide responsive records electronically. If portions are exempt from disclosure, please release all reasonably segregable nonexempt material and identify the applicable exemptions.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Marni LaFleur
